articles.description: The government has made improvements to the Medicare Plan Finder, a key online tool, in time for open enrollment. It helps seniors compare policies to avoid costly surprises.

articles.author: Robert Jimison
articles.title: Senators Urge Trump to Reverse Diesel Deal With Putin
articles.description: A bipartisan group of 12 senators called on the president to drop his decision to ease sanctions on Russia’s exports of diesel fuel, saying the deal would help Moscow continue the war in Ukraine.
articles.content: A bipartisan group of 12 senators called on the president to drop his decision to ease sanctions on Russia’s exports of diesel fuel, saying the deal would help Moscow continue the war in Ukraine.

articles.author: Colby Smith and Tony Romm
articles.title: Lawyer for Fed Governor Cook Denounces Trump’s New Investigation
articles.description: A lawyer for Lisa Cook raised “significant concerns” over the “objectivity and fitness of the committee” assembled by President Trump as a way to remove her as a governor at the Federal Reserve.
